repo.name: mcp-server-chart
repo.description: 🤖 A visualization mcp contains 25+ visual charts using @antvis. Using for chart generation and data analysis.

readme.summary: Well-structured README with clear feature list and installation instructions, but lacks concrete examples and troubleshooting guidance.
readme.top_issue: No troubleshooting section and missing concrete examples of actual chart generation with sample data

injection_risks.description: Potential injection risk in callTool function due to lack of input validation for request.params.name and request.params.arguments

critical_findings: Potential injection risk in callTool function
Lack of input validation for command line arguments and chart data schema
security.summary: The code has some security concerns, including potential injection risks and lack of input validation, but no critical secrets or error exposure issues were found.

common_complaints: Chart rendering issues (filled/saturated appearance, inconsistent axis scaling)
Label display problems (too many labels on line charts, missing thousand separators)
Deployment errors (Docker, TLS handshake, Node.js compatibility)
Missing features (dual-axis support for 3+ data series, configurable label visibility)
UI/UX inconsistencies (different max values for same scores, axis scaling uniformity)
sentiment.summary: Community shows moderate engagement with a mix of bug reports and feature requests; maintainers respond to some issues but several feature requests and complex bugs remain open without resolution, indicating moderate responsiveness rather than active engagement.

communication.summary: Maintainer responses are clear, helpful, and patient. Technical depth is good, and the communication style is welcoming.
